issues.description: The problem statement text refers to a method named get_total_number_of_students() (snake_case), while the UML in the same problem statement and the provided solution implementation use the camelCase name getTotalNumberOfStudents(). This inconsistent naming for the same conceptual method can confuse students about the exact identifier they are expected to implement and how it maps to the template/solution code.
issues.suggestedFix: Make the method name consistent across artifacts. Update problem_statement.md to reference getTotalNumberOfStudents() (camelCase) to match the UML and solution code, or explicitly state that either naming (and their exact Java signature) is acceptable. Ensure template comments and any test descriptions use the same camelCase identifier.
